title: Food Bank & Christmas Lights Run
description:
4 miles in about 45/50 minutes 
Meeting at Victoria Park main car park. 
We'll hunt down a few good lights displays too. 

This is a run to support the Malvern food bank at what is always a difficult time of year. 
I'd love it if people could bring an item that I will take up to the Lyttleton well for them to distribute. 
I will add the current shortages/requests as a discussion post but please feel free to bring anything you may already have that isn't on the list. They will be grateful for all. 

Some of the Malvern light displays have collection tins so please bring a little cash if you'd like to donate to them too. 

Torches and visible clothing required. 
Christmas attire optional 🎄
